Proposition
[Smoothness Is Local]

1. ch2:2.6For a map $F:M\to N$ between smooth manifolds, if every $p\in M$ has a neighborhood on which $F$ is smooth, then $F$ is smooth. Conversely, the restriction of a smooth map to every open subset is smooth.
